_: КОРОТКАЯ СПЕЦИФИКАЦИЯ ДЛЯ ПРОВЕРКИ МОНТАЖА. Не ролик канала: сценарий здесь на четыре коротких главы, чтобы синтетический прогон занимал минуты, а не полчаса. Порядок: python pipeline/mock.py jobs/ancient-test.json && python pipeline/smoke.py jobs/ancient-test.json, либо этап smoke в Actions.
script_blocks: This block exists to check the timeline, not to be watched. It has several sentences of different lengths, because the shot boundaries are taken from sentence ends and a block of identical sentences would hide exactly the problems this run is meant to catch. Some sentences are long and unhurried, the way the narrator actually speaks on this channel. Others are short. The point is variety.

The second block starts a new chapter, and the boundary between chapters is where the longest transition of the video goes. It is worth saying a number here: the city was abandoned around 1200 BC, and nobody has explained it since. That sentence should produce a text card if the style vector asked for one.

The third block is where the pacing curve is usually at its slowest, so the shots here should be the longest in the plan. If any of them ends up with a short camera move, the smoke run fails and says so. That check exists because a still frame held for thirty seconds is the single worst thing this channel can do.

The fourth block closes the test. It is deliberately shorter than the others so that the last shot has to stretch to the end of the audio, which is the case that used to cut the narration off. If the timeline and the audio agree to within half a second, the run passes.
